biotools.summary: spaCR links pooled CRISPR-Cas9 perturbations to single-cell spatial phenotypes in high-content microscopy images. It segments cells, nuclei, pathogens and organelles with Cellpose, measures morphology, intensity, texture and colocalization features into a SQLite project, trains image and measurement classifiers, maps sequencing reads to wells and gRNAs, and estimates per-guide and per-gene effects by regression.

credit.name: Staffan Svard
credit.note: Name is 'Staffan Svard' here; the CITATION.cff spelling is 'Svard' with a-diaeresis.

documentation.note: Installers, extras, update, uninstall and troubleshooting.
Interactive walkthroughs of the core workflow.

function.note: Annotate and Classify modules: keyboard-driven labelling of object crops with active-learning queues, then training of image or measurement-based classifiers, with held-out performance recorded alongside each checkpoint.
Map Barcodes module: assigns sequencing reads to plate wells and to gRNA barcodes, and reports per-well guide abundance with collision and coverage QC.

function.cmd: spacr-run mask --settings settings.csv ; spacr-run measure --settings settings.csv
function.note: Mask and Measure modules: Cellpose segmentation of cells, nuclei, pathogens and organelles, followed by morphology, intensity, texture, spatial and colocalization measurement of every object into a SQLite project, with object crops.
Regression module: estimates guide, gene, condition and control effects with model families suited to continuous, fractional and count responses, and returns a ranked gene-level hit list.
UMAP, gating, graph-building and QC dashboard tools for exploring single-object embeddings and per-plate quality.
